objective: Extend connector reading aids from the current validated FR/ES catalogue to a cautious FR/ES/IT/PT/EN core without data loss or silent activation.

decisions_required_before_execution.decision: Authorize IT/PT/EN as supported connector-help languages and accept that Mission 217 includes application capability changes, not only data.
Validate expressions, functions, register, polysemy, examples and cautions for the 25-cell core matrix.
Validate learner-facing titles, hints, examples and cautions.
Retain the existing secondary variants « mais » and « pero » (recommended) and decide whether « por lo tanto » is added beside « por tanto ».
Choose whether optional lexical links are introduced now or deferred (recommended: defer unless exact-form and semantic policy are both approved).

preconditions: Cleanly identify and preserve all pre-existing repository changes.
Capture a canonical connector_help snapshot, table definition, row count and deterministic hash before any write.
Confirm backup destination, restoration procedure and authenticated ownership of any inserted row.
Run no schema migration: the current table can already reference all documented languages.
Refuse execution if the database state is neither the expected initial state nor a recognized idempotent final state.

phases.name: Human catalogue freeze
actions: Review proposed_multilingual_matrix.json field by field.
Record approvals and unresolved variants without changing the database.
Freeze a machine-readable approved plan with its own SHA-256.

phases.name: Capability before data
actions: Replace the scattered ES/FR allow-lists with one explicit five-language connector-help capability source.
Keep the generic language catalogue unchanged.
Update public/admin validation, repository lookup and analysis consistently.
Update the connector-help contract and tests without changing Seven Sieves.
phases.rollback: Revert only the isolated capability commit; no data will yet have changed.

phases.name: Transactional proposed-row insertion
actions: Insert only approved missing IT/PT/EN rows, initially PROPOSED.
Use explicit language lookup, normalized expression, function and source label; never rely on auto-increment ranges alone.
Keep the existing 12 rows and their identifiers; delete nothing.
Mirror the repository's stricter conflict rule: no second VALIDATED row with the same normalized expression in one language, even under another function.
Commit only after count, field coverage, uniqueness and exact inserted-set reconciliation pass.
phases.rollback: Within the transaction on failure; after commit, delete only rows matching the frozen plan fingerprint and source label, then reconcile the original snapshot exactly.

phases.name: Validation workflow
actions: Expose and review PROPOSED rows through the existing administration workflow.
Promote rows to VALIDATED only after recorded linguistic and pedagogical approval.
Keep rejected or unresolved candidates non-public.
phases.rollback: Return only Mission 217 rows to PROPOSED using the authenticated frozen set.

phases.name: Canonical seed alignment
actions: After successful canonical reconciliation, update the current draft seed so fresh environments do not diverge.
Keep insertion idempotent and preserve human-review status semantics.
phases.rollback: Revert the isolated seed change; canonical database rollback remains independent.

phases.name: End-to-end verification
actions: Run static syntax and targeted automated tests.
Exercise public/admin HTTP filters for all five languages.
Exercise POST /analysis with one candidate per language and all multi-token candidates.
Verify the learner toggle remains hidden by default and independent from Seven Sieves.
Perform a human Chromium recipe and record it separately from Codex checks.
phases.rollback: No mutation during recipe; on failure, stop activation and keep new rows PROPOSED.

idempotence_contract.initial_state: Exact expected count/hash and no Mission 217 source rows.
idempotence_contract.final_state: Every frozen candidate exists once with the expected fields and no unexpected source rows.
idempotence_contract.partial_state: Some, but not all, frozen candidates exist or fields differ; refuse automatic repair and report a reconciliation diff.
idempotence_contract.unknown_state: Unexpected duplicates, source ownership ambiguity or initial hash mismatch; abort before write.

minimum_test_matrix: Leading/trailing punctuation accepted; punctuation inside a multi-token expression rejected.
Collapsed spaces, repeated spaces and newlines inside multi-token expressions.
Two-token candidates: sin embargo, no entanto, de plus, parce que, além disso.
Optional three-token candidate if approved: por lo tanto.
All five discourse-function labels in the learner view.
Public data excludes PROPOSED rows until explicit validation.
Teacher view consumes only the count; learner view consumes details.
No eighth sieve and no change to Seven Sieves results.
demo_30_to_45_seconds: Open a prepared learner session containing five short sentences, one per language.
Show that Seven Sieves results are already visible while reading aids remain hidden.
Click « Afficher les aides à la lecture ».
Point out one multi-token match (« Sin embargo » or « Além disso »), its human function label, hint, contextual example and caution.
Hide the aids again and state that this is optional scaffolding, not an eighth sieve.
versioning: To be decided per affected component during Mission 217; Mission 216 is documentary and changes no application version.
